description: High-fashion magazine cover/editorial energy. Choose a mood: glossy cover, dark cinematic, hard-flash conceptual, painterly Renaissance, dreamlike fairy-tale, black-and-white natural, or off-duty candid. Returns the styled prompt stack for your shot and the aspect_ratio to make it at — pair it with generate_image and pass that aspect_ratio along.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional frame shape. Replaces the shape the style uses by default. The answer carries aspect_ratio: pass it to generate_image so the picture is made at that shape.

style.description: glossy_cover = slat-shadow magazine cover gloss. dark_cinematic = deep shadow, flash + ambient, edge of menace. hard_flash_conceptual = direct flash, velvet texture. painterly_renaissance = raking sunlight, Renaissance grade. dreamlike_fairytale = Noctilux chiaroscuro. black_and_white_natural = natural light, no makeup. off_duty_candid = morning window light, relaxed.

subject.description: What you want to shoot. E.g. "a woman walking through a hotel lobby" or "morning coffee on the balcony".

name: apply_high_fashion_editorial
title: Apply High Fashion Editorial
